consent.title: Performance measurement
consent.body: With your consent, DevStash measures in your browser how fast its pages load and respond (LCP, INP and CLS) and sends these three numbers with the kind of page: never its address, nothing you stored, no cookie, no tracking across sites. You can change your answer at any time under Privacy settings.
